const CACHE_NAME='digital5-cache-v1';const ASSETS=['/','/index.html'];self.addEventListener('install',event=>{event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache=>cache.addAll(ASSETS)));self.skipWaiting();});self.addEventListener('activate',event=>{event.waitUntil(self.clients.claim());});self.addEventListener('fetch',event=>{if(event.request.method!=='GET')return;event.respondWith(caches.match(event.request).then(cached=>cached||fetch(event.request)));});// Listen for skipWaiting message from the client
self.addEventListener('message',event=>{if(event.data&&event.data.type==='SKIP_WAITING'){self.skipWaiting();}});
